title: users.events envelope
description: The wire shape for every record on the users.events topic (event-driven/README.md). Unlike event-sourcing/'s single translated UserContactUpdated schema, this describes the raw union of all ten Users domain events, because in this architecture the raw log itself is the shared artifact — there is no translated boundary event.

aggregateId.description: The userId; also the Kafka message key.

data.description: Shape depends on 'type' — see services/Users/Users.Domain/Events.cs for the ten record definitions this mirrors field-for-field.
